question: Identify spatially variable genes (FDR < 0.05) in the provided spatial gene expression data using Moran's I spatial autocorrelation.

expected_output.description: rows as genes, columns should include gene_name (gene name), I_stat (Moran's I statistic), pval_norm (p-value), pval_norm_fdr_bh (FDR-adjusted p-value)
